SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK CQL-09: CQL - Comparison Operators. Test these items: Between, Equal, Equivalent, Greater, GreaterOrEqual, Less, LessOrEqual, NotEqual, NotEquivalent. SKEPTIC should focus on adversarial boundary cases: null/unknown propagation, mixed scalar types, Quantity unit compatibility, Date/DateTime/Time precision, tuple/list comparison, interval comparison, direct public DuckDB helper calls, native-loaded versus forced Python fallback parity, and generated SQL execution in scalar and population-style contexts.

This is the actual per-chunk/per-personality workflow. Start from scratch for this chunk/personality and do not inspect or rely on any archived prior workflow outputs under .ai_loop/spec_comp/**, including any older CQL-09 artifacts. Current source code, active state files, GLOBAL_RULES.md, GLOBAL_KNOWLEDGE.md, AGENTS.md, and current tests may be inspected. Maintain 100% conformance and no pytest regressions.

When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.
